desc: With the portrait of former Secretary George Marshall in the background, Cuban Minister for Foreign Trade and Foreign Investment Rodrigo Malmierca signs U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry's guestbook before their bilateral meeting at the U.S. Department of State in Washington, D.C., on February 18,
